BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 ofthe Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning

Ordinance is hereby amended by changing all of the Bl-1 Neighborhood Shopping

District symbols as shown on Map No. 2-M

in the area bounded by:



West Fillmore Street; South Menard Avenue; a line 70.02 feet next south of and

parallel to West Fillmore Street; and the public alley next west of and parallel to South

Menard Avenue.



To those of an RT4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District
